answer: Fake identities gain nothing because the bond exceeds any reward a single epoch can yield, so mass registration burns capital faster than it earns. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond to register, and peers attest work through a randomized challenge. Honest agents cross-check attestations, and any forged claim is a ridge the network refuses to cross. A quiet whisper of collusion triggers slashing, while verified contribution flows like nectar to real participants. From once0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
